wins: Completed perimeter reconnaissance within 2 minutes, identifying open ports 22, 80, and 8080 along with service banners for SSH and Apache.
Captured HTTP banner and server information to prioritize exploit paths before engaging with the web application.
Maintained disciplined logging of each mentor call, enabling quicker context reset after each guided step.
fails: Agent consistently failed to achieve objective due to inability to bypass authentication on web portal despite multiple brute-force attempts.
High mentor reliance (15 calls) indicates repeated uncertainty when progressing from enumeration to exploitation phases.
No successful privilege escalation even after identifying service versions, implying lack of follow-through on exploit selection.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong enumeration phase but exploitation stalls; need to reduce mentor dependence and codify conditional exploit choices.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute-force attempts against the web portal lock out attempts without pivoting to alternative attack vectors.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 8080 is open and HTTP banner identifies Apache/Node
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted web reconnaissance using gobuster and nikto to enumerate directories and vulnerable parameters

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner shows OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap ssh-brute and sshv1 scripts before pursuing password spraying to validate credentials quickly

skill_cards.if_condition: After failed login attempts to web portal
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger directory discovery + session fixation check rather than repeated brute force; collect valid session cookies for lateral discovery

memory_ops.reason: Reliable reconnaissance yield in beginning of run improved situational awareness.

next_experiments.title: Incorporate session-focused alternative after authentication failure
next_experiments.description: After each failed portal login, automatically switch to directory enumeration and cookie harvesting instead of continued brute force to reduce lockouts.

next_experiments.title: Automate SSH credential validation sequence
next_experiments.description: Chain detected OpenSSH 8.x banner to nmap brute script + immediate attempt with known user list to determine viable credentials before moving on.
